sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS/NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES TODAY. AHEAD OF THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH...AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY SHOULD BE IN PLACE BY THIS AFTERNOON EXTENDING FROM THE CNTRL PLAINS NNWWD INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS ERN MT...NE WY AND WRN SD BY MID-AFTERNOON WITH CONVECTION CONSOLIDATING INTO SEVERAL PERSISTENT CLUSTERS BY EARLY EVENING. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE REGION AT 00Z MONDAY SHOW THE BEST COMBINATION OF INSTABILITY AND DEEP LAYER SHEAR FROM NW NEB NNWWD ACROSS WRN SD INTO FAR SE MT WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE FORECAST IN THE 2500 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE WITH 0-6 K SHEAR OF 45 TO 55 KT. A PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD EXTEND FROM WY NEWD INTO WRN SD WHERE A CONCENTRATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL SHOULD EXIST. HAIL GREATER THAN 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS. A TORNADO THREAT SHOULD ALSO EXIST DUE TO BACKED SFC WINDS AND SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW-LEVELS. A SEVERE MCS SHOULD EVENTUALLY ORGANIZE AND MOVE EWD ACROSS SD AND NRN NEB DURING THE EVENING.

sections.title: MID-MO VALLEY/OZARKS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE SHOULD BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS TODAY WITH AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY BENEATH THE UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE FROM WRN AR NWWD INTO ERN KS BY MID-AFTERNOON. IN THE WAKE OF MORNING CONVECTION...THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO REDEVELOP IN NE KS SEWD ACROSS SCNTRL MO BY LATE AFTERNOON ON THE ERN EDGE OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS NEAR THE NOSE OF A LOW-LEVEL JET. THIS CONVECTION SHOULD EXPAND IN COVERAGE THIS EVENING...MOVING ESEWD ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN NE KS AND SCNTRL MO AT 03Z SHOW MODERATE INSTABILITY...STRONG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS AND STEEP LAPSE RATES. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.

sections.title: ERN GULF COAST STATES/CAROLINAS/MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IS FORECAST TO BE IN PLACE FROM THE TN VALLEY NEWD ACROSS THE SRN APPALACHIANS INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC TODAY AS AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH MOVES EWD ACROSS THE REGION. MODEL FORECASTS INITIATE NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS BY EARLY AFTERNOON MAINLY DUE TO SFC HEATING. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY...STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WITH LINE-SEGMENTS AND THE MORE INTENSE PULSE STORMS. ..BROYLES/ROGERS.. 06/12/2011

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: SHORT WAVE TROUGH OVER THE COLUMBIA PLATEAU INTO NRN ROCKIES WILL TRANSLATE NEWD INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS BY THIS EVENING...HASTENING THE DEVELOPMENT AND SUBSEQUENT DEEPENING OF A SURFACE LOW OVER ERN WY. SUSTAINED SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF THE SURFACE CYCLONE AND ATTENDANT LEE TROUGH WILL ALLOW BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS TO CLIMB THROUGH THE 50S BENEATH THE NRN EXTENT OF EML/STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME...RESULTING IN AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH MIDLEVEL TROUGH COUPLED WITH CONVERGENCE INVOF SURFACE LOW AND OROGRAPHIC INFLUENCES WILL FOSTER SCATTERED TSTMS BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON FROM ERN PARTS OF MT/WY INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS AND NEB PNHDL. THE COMBINATION OF THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH 40-50 KT OF DEEP WLY SHEAR WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITH A THREAT FOR A FEW TORNADOES AND LARGE HAIL. DIURNAL STORM ACTIVITY MAY GROW UPSCALE INTO MESOSCALE SYSTEM TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS SPREADING EWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS INTO MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: DEPARTURE OF SHORT WAVE TROUGH INTO THE MID MS VALLEY COUPLED WITH INTENSIFICATION OF UPSTREAM TROUGH OVER THE GREAT BASIN INTO SWRN DESERTS WILL RESULT IN CONSIDERABLE AMPLIFICATION OF MIDLEVEL RIDGE ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH THE D1 PERIOD. THIS LARGE-SCALE PATTERN EVOLUTION WILL SERVE TO REFORTIFY THE EML AND ASSOCIATED CAPPING INVERSION ACROSS MUCH OF THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS. MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF TSTMS ARE ONGOING FROM SWRN MO/NWRN AR INTO CNTRL/WRN KS IN CONJUNCTION WITH MIGRATORY SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME PRESENT ON THE UPSTREAM SIDE OF THIS MIDLEVEL FEATURE. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD UNDERGO DIURNAL WEAKENING WHILE SHIFTING EWD ACROSS THE REGION THIS MORNING. RESIDUAL CLOUD DEBRIS AND CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW WILL SERVE TO SHARPEN LARGER-SCALE BAROCLINIC ZONE WHICH WILL BECOME ESTABLISHED FROM A DEEPENING SURFACE LOW OVER SERN CO EWD THROUGH CNTRL KS AND THEN SEWD INTO W-CNTRL OR SWRN MO. DUE TO THE REBOUNDING MIDLEVEL HEIGHTS AND STRENGTHENING OF THE CAP...DIURNAL STORM INITIATION ALONG THIS BOUNDARY REMAINS IN QUESTION. HOWEVER...THERE IS SOME SUGGESTION IN MODEL GUIDANCE THAT A WEAK MIDLEVEL PERTURBATION WILL PROGRESS FROM ERN CO ACRO

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC STATES INTO CAROLINAS
sections.text: DEEP-LAYER CYCLONE CENTERED NEAR THE ONTARIO/QUEBEC BORDER WILL PROGRESS EWD TODAY AS A 50-60 KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK ROUNDS THE TROUGH BASE AND PROPAGATES TOWARD THE NEWD ENGLAND COAST. THIS MIDLEVEL PATTERN EVOLUTION WILL PROMOTE THE EWD/SEWD PROGRESSION OF SURFACE COLD FRONT WITH THIS BOUNDARY LIKELY EXTENDING FROM THE HUDSON AND DE RIVER VALLEYS INTO THE PIEDMONT REGION BY THIS EVENING. MORNING VISIBLE SATELLITE DATA SUGGEST THAT WIDESPREAD CLOUDINESS WILL TEMPER DAYTIME HEATING AND RESULTANT AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT GENERALLY N OF THE MASON-DIXON LINE WHERE THE STRONGER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS FORECAST TO RESIDE. ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THIS REGION...THOUGH UNCERTAINTIES IN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY THAT CAN DEVELOP PRIOR TO FROPA PRECLUDE DELINEATION OF A SLIGHT RISK AREA ATTM. FARTHER S FROM THE DELMARVA INTO CAROLINAS...A HOT AND MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL YIELD A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT TODAY WITH MLCAPE VALUES INCREASING TO 1500-2500 J/KG. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK...BUT THE PRESENCE OF THE MODERATE INSTABILITY...STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND APPROACH OF THE SURFACE FRONT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT CLUSTERS OF S

sections.title: KS/OK/MO/AR THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: A COMPLICATED FORECAST SCENARIO CENTERED ON KS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. AN INITIAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM CENTRAL AR WWD INTO SRN/CENTRAL OK...WHILE A REINFORCING OUTFLOW IS SLOWING ITS SWD/SWWD MOTION ACROSS SRN KS/NRN OK. THE SYNOPTIC FRONT IS LOCATED FARTHER TO THE N ACROSS SRN MO AND NE KS. THE SRN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY LOSE DEFINITION AND DRIFT NWD THIS AFTERNOON...WHILE THE REINFORCING OUTFLOW STALLS ACROSS CENTRAL KS/NRN OK AS THE DRIVING CONVECTION DIMINISHES IN CONJUNCTION WITH WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL WAA...AND AS THE REMNANT MCV MOVES EWD OVER MO. A WEAK MIDLEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER ERN CO WILL MOVE EWD/NEWD OVER KS/NEB...BUT GENERAL HEIGHT RISES ARE EXPECTED OVER THE SRN/CENTRAL PLAINS. THE RISING HEIGHTS AND SWWD DISPLACEMENT OF THE MORNING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM THE SYNOPTIC FRONT...AND BENEATH AN INCREASINGLY WARM EML...ALL INTRODUCE UNCERTAINTY REGARDING NEW STORM FORMATION IN KS THIS AFTERNOON. IF STORMS WERE TO FORM...SUPERCELLS WOULD BE LIKELY WITH A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS TORNADOES...THUS WILL MAINTAIN A HIGHLY CONDITIONAL SLIGHT RISK AREA FOR THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. A GREATER RISK FOR STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL IS EXPECTED TONIGHT AS THE RESIDUA

sections.title: WRN SD AND VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER ERN ID WILL EJECT ENEWD TO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS BY THIS EVENING...AND HELP MAINTAIN AN INVERTED TROUGH ACROSS ERN WY/SE MT. E OF THE TROUGH...BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 55-60 F AND SURFACE HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS WILL ALLOW MLCAPE TO INCREASE TO 1500-2500 J/KG AND CONVECTIVE INHIBITION TO WEAKEN. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL BE COMPLEMENTED BY WIND PROFILES WITH SUFFICIENT BULK SHEAR AND HODOGRAPH CURVATURE TO PROMOTE SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT. EXPECT INITIAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT BY MID AFTERNOON ACROSS NE WY AND SE MT...WITH CONVECTION SUBSEQUENTLY SPREADING NEWD ACROSS WRN SD AND SW ND. THE INITIAL STORMS WILL BE MORE DISCRETE AND CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A CLUSTER/MCS IS EXPECTED THIS EVENING...WITH THE SEVERE THREATS SHIFTING TO PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: ERN PA SWD TO NC THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A SURFACE COLD FRONT IS MOVING SEWD INTO CENTRAL PA AND NRN WV/KY...WHILE A BACKDOOR FRONT HAS STALLED ACROSS SRN NJ AND ERN PA. THE COLD FRONT IS ASSOCIATED WITH A MIDLEVEL TROUGH MOVING EWD TOWARD THE SAINT LAWRENCE VALLEY...WITH A SWD EXTENDING LOBE TOWARD WRN PA. AN ACCOMPANYING BELT OF 30-50 KT WLY FLOW IN THE 500-300 MB LAYER WILL EXTEND AS FAR S AS NRN VA/MD/PA THIS AFTERNOON IN THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR. INITIAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING ALONG THE COLD FRONT ACROSS SW/CENTRAL/NE PA...AND SOME INTENSIFICATION OF THIS CONVECTION IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AS IT ENCOUNTERS A REGION OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING AND RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE W OF THE BACKDOOR FRONT. LAPSE RATE PROFILES WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STEEP AND ARE SUGGESTIVE OF ONLY A MARGINAL HAIL THREAT...BUT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT WILL SUPPORT A FEW ORGANIZED STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS THIS AFTERNOON. DEEP-LAYER FLOW AND VERTICAL WEAKEN BOTH WEAKEN WITH SWD EXTENT ACROSS VA/NC. HERE...THE ENVIRONMENT WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE CONDUCIVE TO THE FORMATION OF MULTICELL CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A FEW DAMAGING DOWN

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC STATES/DELMARVA/CAROLINAS
sections.text: FEW CHANGES...SEE PRIOR DISCUSSION AS BELOW AND SUBSEQUENT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS INCLUDING SPC MD 1195.

sections.title: KS AND THE ADJACENT MO VALLEY
sections.text: THE LIKELIHOOD/EXTENT OF SURFACE BASED DEEP CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT STILL REMAINS QUESTIONABLE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING IN VICINITY OF MULTIPLE NORTHWARD RETURNING WEAK OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES ACROSS OK/SOUTHERN KS AND/OR THE FRONTAL ZONE THAT A RESIDES A BIT FARTHER NORTH ACROSS KS. AS PREVIOUSLY DISCUSSED...THE MORE CERTAIN SCENARIO IS FOR TSTMS WITH A RISK OF SEVERE TO INCREASE LATER TONIGHT.

sections.title: NORTHERN-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ONE CHANGE AT 20Z WAS TO EXTEND THE SLIGHT RISK SOUTHWARD INTO NORTHERN CO...WHERE CONCERN FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS EXISTS ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS. THIS IS GENERALLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO A RELATIVELY MOIST HIGH PLAINS AIR MASS/WEAK UPSLOPE AND A SPEED MAX CROSSING CO AS NOTED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY/DERIVED WIND DATA. OTHERWISE...SEE PRIOR REASONING BELOW AND TORNADO WATCH 468. ..GUYER.. 06/12/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SUN JUN 12 2011/

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS/NRN PLAINS
sections.text: SEVERAL THUNDERSTORMS CLUSTERS ARE ONGOING FROM SW ND SWD ACROSS WRN ND INTO WRN NEB ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. THE STORMS ARE JUST AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY MOVING EWD INTO THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS. A 40 TO 50 KT MID-LEVEL JET ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS NOSING INTO THE NRN PLAINS CREATING STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES. THE RAPID CITY WSR-88D VWPS HAS 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 40 TO 50 KT AND SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR BELOW 2 KM. THIS IS CREATING CONDITIONS FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE-SEGMENTS. THIS COMBINED WITH THE INSTABILITY AND VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR LARGE HAIL SO WILL MAINTAIN A 30 PERCENT HAIL PROBABILITY DUE TO A CONCENTRATED HAIL THREAT THIS EVENING. IN ADDITION...THE STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET WILL MAINTAIN A TORNADO THREAT WITH THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS. AS THE STORMS GRADUALLY ORGANIZE INTO AN MCS...THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD PERSIST INTO THE LATE EVENING AND PERHAPS THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD MOVING EWD ACROSS THE CNTRL DAKOTAS. FOR THIS REASON...HAVE EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK EWD TO ACCOUNT FOR THE NIGHT-TIME SEVERE THREAT.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS AND OZARKS
sections.text: A MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS IN PLACE ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS BENEATH AND UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. THE UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE HAS HELPED TO SUPPRESS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AND WHETHER STORMS CAN INITIATE ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS THIS EVENING REMAINS QUESTIONABLE. MODEL FORECASTS STRENGTHEN THE CAPPING INVERSION WITH TIME SUGGESTING ANY STORM DEVELOPMENT TONIGHT WILL BE ELEVATED IN NATURE. IF A CLUSTER OF STORMS CAN INITIATE IN SE KS THIS EVENING AS THE HRRR MODEL SUGGESTS SHOULD HAVE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL GIVEN THAT ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY...STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. HAVE MAINTAINED THE SLIGHT RISK FOR THE AREA WHERE THE POTENTIAL FOR INITIATION APPEARS TO BE THE GREATEST.

sections.title: CAROLINAS AND ERN VA
sections.text: A BROKEN LINE OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS LOCATED FROM SE VA...SWWD ACROSS CNTRL NC INTO NRN SC ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. AS THE STORMS MOVE SEWD INTO THE COASTAL PLAINS OF THE CAROLINAS EARLY THIS EVENING...A FEW OF THE STRONGER CELLS MAY PRODUCE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS DUE TO THE STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATE IN PLACE. THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD RAPIDLY DECREASE AFTER 01Z AS INSTABILITY DECREASES ACROSS THE REGION.

sections.title: WEST TX
sections.text: SEVERAL THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING IN WEST TX BETWEEN MIDLAND AND LUBBOCK LOCATED NEAR A POCKET OF INSTABILITY WITH MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING SBCAPE VALUES AROUND 500 J/KG. IN SPITE OF THE WEAK INSTABILITY...LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE VERY STEEP EXCEEDING 9.0 C/KM. THIS COMBINED WITH 30 TO 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT WITH THE STORMS MAINLY DUE TO THE LARGE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS IN PLACE. ..BROYLES.. 06/13/2011
